title: OceanScope public field demonstration
limitations: Public read-only demonstration of existing cached outputs; visitors do not upload files or run new comparisons.
A small set of original-resolution field frames is included for interactive 3D inspection. Metric curves retain all 96 existing frames (1001–1096).
The saved SDF comparison declares metres. Where field units are blank, they remain undeclared. Unit declarations are simulation conventions, not independently verified real-world calibration.
The prediction dataset is identified by its existing DA3 GT-free volumemasked filename. No training method, test split, or independent accuracy certification is inferred.
DA3 prediction exterior values are filled. Distance scores use conditional GT-water support, not full-domain SDF accuracy. Read distance errors together with coverage and occupancy metrics.
Prediction display surfaces are illustrative. Surface-distance and elevation errors are unavailable for these filled exterior predictions. No cross-model ranking is included.
